title: The judge's level is checked and stored, but the learner sees the rules' level
subtitle: The chat is real test data from Lomem's code. The readout numbers in step 6 are made up (example).

steps.label: the answer that reaches the wind-down
claim the judge for this chat
tutor reply, no wait for the judge

rules say B1 · judge says B2,
one level up

judge error → log it,

bar written first:
right in ≥ 30 of 38

outcome.title: No learner saw a change: Lomem dropped its real judge the same day
lines: The judge only ran in shadow. Had it cleared the bar, a flag would show learners its accepted level.

captions.title: Start the judge once, then answer without waiting
captions.text: When the chat reaches its wind-down, the server claims the judge by writing a start time. The claim succeeds only once per chat. The tutor's reply goes back without waiting for the judge.

captions.title: The judge reads the answers, never the rules' level
captions.text: The judge gets the answered turns and their facts, but not the rules' level, so it cannot copy it. In the real test it replies B2 and cites turns 5 and 7.

captions.title: Code checks whether the judge's level has evidence
captions.text: Two or more levels from the rules is rejected. One level up needs two cited turns that pass the B2 check and no failed B2 question. Rules B1, judge B2: accepted.

captions.title: Store the comparison next to the answer
captions.text: The server writes `judge_level` B2 and `judge_would_change` true, only in the judge's own columns. Later someone can count disagreements without re-running anything.

captions.title: The learner still sees the rules' level
captions.text: Nothing the judge says reaches the learner yet: the learner sees B1. If the judge fails, the server logs it and keeps the rules' level.

captions.title: A person reads the disagreements against a bar written first
captions.text: The team counts `judge_would_change`: 38 of 412 chats (example). A person reads each one against the bar, right in ≥ 30 of 38. Lomem dropped its real judge the same day, and no learner saw a change.
